Pasteback 0.4.0 — A roomier workspace / 更从容的窗口
• A standard Mac window with dragging, resizing, minimization and full screen. Window size and position are remembered. • Persistent sidebar navigation for history and Settings. Return without losing your search and selection. • Browse history and full content side by side. Copy whole entries or select text in the detail pane.
• 标准 Mac 窗口，支持自由拖动、缩放、最小化和全屏，记住窗口大小与位置。 • 历史与设置使用同一窗口，侧栏随时切换，返回保留搜索与选择。 • 列表与详情并排，单击直接查看完整内容，可复制全部或拖选文字。
This release focuses only on window layout. Clipboard capture, privacy settings and existing shortcuts remain available. Update inside Pasteback; your history is preserved. 本次仅改造窗口。保留既有记录能力、隐私设置及快捷键，历史记录保留。
